about: Hand-labelled eligibility terms for the Clerk extraction eval. Each label was checked against the live official page on the asOf date. Arrays list every acceptable answer; null means the rules do not state it, so the right answer is 'unknown' (inventing a value is an error). 'contains:x' passes if the extracted list has an entry containing x.

events.name: Google Cloud AI Builder Cup 2026: terms and conditions
events.notes: The terms give the roster lock (October 11) but no prototype deadline; the deadline lives on the event microsite. A model that answers 2026-10-18 is guessing.
